identityCautions.name: Elder variants
identityCautions.finding: AVP2004 Elder, Greyback, PHG Elder, the V3 Elder project mask, Elder Belize, Elder Tartarus and Gotham Elder are separate identities/labels. Elder Belize/Tartarus/Gotham costume labels have no primary mask pixels established locally.

identityCautions.name: Hornhead
identityCautions.finding: Small horns are biological head features. They cannot be added to the mask without a licensed mask-on reference.

archiveAudit.finding: No named target provenance found for Ahab, Afghanistan, Golden Angel, Hornhead, Big Mama or Spiked Tail among the archive-audit reference records. The references are PHG and Badlands material; material reconstructions are not biomask geometry authority. This was a metadata/provenance screen, not a fresh visual review of every archived pixel.
